text:
Hey! Great question about Plant Club! 🌱

Unfortunately, you **can't choose the specific plant** that comes in your monthly box — that's part of the fun surprise! Each month you get a plant that matches your light level.

**What you can do:**
- List up to **3 plants you already own** in your Plant Club preferences, and we'll make sure not to send you duplicates
- Choose between **Starter** ($29/month, small 4-inch plants) or **Collector** ($49/month, medium or rare 6-inch plants) — so you have some control over the size and rarity level

The plants you receive are covered by our normal Plant Care Guarantee, so you're all set if anything goes wrong.

Is there anything else you'd like to know about Plant Club, or would you like help setting up your preferences? 😊
